outcomes.scope: Conditional single-run analysis assuming independent stochastic requests within each arm/question. Same seeds do not imply matched trajectories. Shared serving batches and between-boot effects are not modeled. BCa intervals are pointwise; degenerate empirical fallback is explicitly labeled. Question-level score intervals retain boundary uncertainty. A difference without statistical significance does not establish equivalence.

usable_rate_score_interval.method: Newcombe hybrid Wilson; independent binomial samples

complete_costs_and_gate_decision.boundary_interpretation: Existing Newcombe-Wilson helper also applied to total equal-sized counts as a pooled independent-binomial sensitivity/finite screen. Overall empirical bootstrap may be degenerate for all-success runs and is not proof of equivalence. Question-level score intervals remain in outcomes.json. All methods are conditional on independent requests; shared serving batches and one boot per arm limit inference.
complete_costs_and_gate_decision.quality_energy_scope: Whole warm-worker CLI run, including its metadata probe, 10-token warmup and harness/grading idle. Model startup excluded. Gross GPU-board only; original quality control has no energy window, so do not claim a quality-energy reduction.
